posts.text:
🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸

Happy 250th birthday to the greatest country to have ever existed in human history.

There is no other place that compares. There is no country with our freedom, liberty and prosperity. We are the greatest that ever was and ever will be. Thank you to our founding fathers for creating this incredible experiment that has prospered for so long.

We love you America, never change. 

🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸
posts.summary: Celebrates American exceptionalism and founding principles
